sections.Heading: Current state
sections.Text: Pack two measures of clay and set the box at this loading marker. Manual carrying remains free.

sections.Heading: How to use
sections.Text:
Carry one measure at a time or both loose without a fee. To hire the porter, pack both measures into the box and bring it here.
Cost and limits: A shorter clear walk can lower the next fare. The hire quote includes the current route and the weight of the packed box.
Right now you can: hire porter (7 drams).

sections.Heading: Description
sections.Text: The porter takes a packed clay box from this spot to the shelf by the well. Speak here after packing. Carry it yourself if the route is unsafe or the fare is too dear.
